about.title: About Us
about.text1: I am Laura Forero, co-founder of Colombia Tech Week, Tech Fest and Lens PR entrepreneur and public relations professional passionate about creating communities, press, events and strengthening ecosystems for startups, VC funds, financial institutions and public or private entities in Colombia and LATAM.
about.text2: With over 10 years of experience in public relations, communication strategies and high-impact entrepreneurship programs for government, cooperation and companies, I have learned to understand in detail the needs of the tech sector and take brands to the next level.

lensPRInfo.title: More about LENS PR
lensPRInfo.paragraph1: LENS PR is a boutique public relations agency specialized in the tech sector with operations in over 10 countries in LATAM, the US, and Spain. We connect founders, startups, and VC funds with their audiences or clients through tailor-made press, communication, high-level events, and strategic alliances.
lensPRInfo.paragraph2: With over 400 publications for our clients and more than 50 tailor-made events, we have established ourselves as key players in the tech ecosystem in Colombia and LATAM.
lensPRInfo.paragraph3: Global companies such as DEEL, Blackrock, Forbes-promising startups like Yuno and Celes, and notable VCs like FEMSA Ventures, Newtopia VC, Latitud, as well as the most important local ecosystem event, Colombia Tech Week, have trusted us.

freePress.title: Press & Visibility
freePress.description: With over 400 publications for our clients and more than 50 tailor-made events, we have established ourselves as key players in the tech ecosystem in Colombia and LATAM. Global companies like DEEL and Blackrock, Forbes-promising startups such as Yuno and Celes, notable VCs like FEMSA Ventures, Newtopia VC, Latitud, and Colombia Tech Week —the most important local event— have trusted us.

mediaAdvertising.title: Strategic Media Buying
mediaAdvertising.description: We design and run paid media campaigns across digital, print, OOH and broadcast outlets that reach your buyers where decisions are made. From programmatic display and paid social on LinkedIn and Meta to high-impact placements in business and lifestyle press, every dollar is tied to measurable results: pipeline, brand recall and conversion.

experienceDesign.kicker: BRAND EXPERIENCE · CREATIVE DIRECTION · VISUAL IDENTITY
experienceDesign.title: Experience Design & Art Direction
experienceDesign.description: We build visual systems and brand experiences that turn your story into something memorable. Our team develops creative direction, identity and narrative for launches, campaigns and immersive events, making sure every touchpoint feels intentional and on-brand, from keynote stages to digital assets.

eventProduction.title: Event Production & BTL
eventProduction.description: From private investor dinners and product launches to large-format conferences and BTL activations, we handle production end-to-end: concept, logistics, vendors, on-site execution and post-event analytics. We've delivered 500+ experiences across LATAM, the U.S. and Europe for startups, VCs and global brands.

mediaOutreach.kicker: JOURNALIST RELATIONS · PRESS PITCHING · KEY OUTLETS
mediaOutreach.title: Media Outreach & Press Relations
mediaOutreach.description: We open the doors that matter. We curate targeted media lists and pitch journalists at top-tier business, tech and niche outlets across 12+ countries. With long-standing relationships at Forbes, Bloomberg Línea, Contxto, El Tiempo, La Nación and more, we secure the coverage that builds trust with investors, clients and ecosystem.

corporateMerch.title: Corporate Merch & Swag
corporateMerch.description: Custom merch your team and clients actually want to keep. We design, source and ship branded apparel, tech accessories, sustainable kits and onboarding boxes for startups and global brands. From a 50-piece launch drop to multi-country employee swag programs, we manage production and logistics across LATAM and the U.S.

venueScouting.kicker: VENUE SOURCING · LOCATION SCOUTING · EVENT SPACES
venueScouting.title: Venue Scouting
venueScouting.description: We know the rooftops, members clubs, galleries, vineyards and conference centers that elevate a brand. We scout, negotiate and contract venues that fit your audience, format and budget across 10+ cities in Latin America, the U.S. and Europe, so you can focus on the experience.

influencerMarketing.title: Influencer Marketing
influencerMarketing.description: We identify, brief and run campaigns with creators and thought leaders who already speak to your audience: founders, VCs, fintech voices, lifestyle hosts and tech reviewers. From single-creator activations to multi-market programs, we manage briefs, contracts, content approval and performance reporting.

photoVideoCoverage.kicker: EVENT PHOTOGRAPHY · CORPORATE VIDEO · CONTENT CAPTURE
photoVideoCoverage.title: Photo & Video Coverage
photoVideoCoverage.description: We turn every event into a content engine. Our crews deliver professional photo and video coverage —recap reels, founder interviews, social cutdowns and broadcast-ready footage— within hours, not days. Built for press kits, post-event recaps, paid distribution and your sales team's next pitch.

podcastLivestream.title: Podcast & Live Streaming Production
podcastLivestream.description: We produce branded podcasts and live broadcasts that turn your founders and clients into the voices the ecosystem follows. From show strategy and guest sourcing to studio recording, multi-camera live streaming on LinkedIn and YouTube, and SEO-optimized show notes, transcripts and clips that keep ranking long after the episode airs.
